set.body: Goal: land the completed graphics hardening work from the working tree as a reviewable commit series, isolated from unrelated uncommitted changes (archive, connectivity, motion, docs unrelated to graphics). Proposed series mirrors the epic: (1) AesEnv + ScaleRegistry; (2) device layer, numeric length resolution, y-up orientation + SVG rewrite; (3) compiler phases + group-aware lowering; (4) GuidePolicy + scale-derived guides and panel ranges; (5) layout solver + DesignGraphics migration; (6) renderer conformance harness; (7) review fixes (legend/right-axis, rotation handedness, MixedPositionScaling, deterministic labeler, stacked legends) + .jvmopts + docs/README. Acceptance: each commit compiles and tests green on JVM+JS in isolation or the series is squashed to the largest green units; no unrelated files included; commit messages reference the mote issue ids.
set.title: Graphics: commit hardening epic as logical series
